item_verdicts.diff: Two commits. 776a1c613 adds _positive_rate, _historical_reference_rate (a 5-minute-bucketed lru_cache over committed ledger rows, median positive throughput.tokens_per_second for the same backend and model in the trailing seven days, requiring >=10 rates; else (None, count)), _budget_overrun_cause (returns {} when no overrun; reads the run's rate, resolves a same-model reference, labels lane-saturated when rate < reference/2, over-large when at a normal rate the token allowance was exceeded or the volume would exceed the seconds allowance at the reference rate, else unknown; carries rate, reference rate, cohort size and source), and calls it at both budget-overrun-producing sites: _apply_budget_watchdog (recovery.py:4069) and classify_pointer (recovery.py:8499). It also adds LIVE_OVERRUN_FIELDS to reckon/crew/query.py's _live_field_vocabulary so a live query can ask for the cause while every run is inside its allowance. f237a2f20 adds the HTML evidence fragment.
